method: retrospective daily perfect-foresight outage counterfactual; single-day outages only
sample_design: monthly median DA-value and high-value day, start intervals 0/6/12/18; not random
notes: Outage mask prohibits charge and discharge; optimal dispatch may shift
Known outage timing and price perfect foresight may understate unexpected losses
Purposive sample; not estimated outage distributions
DA-only; omits RA/AS/RT/contract penalties, repairs, safety, warranty and other risks
No provider rank without comparable quotes and actual reliability observations
